guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: For the full year 2026, the Company is raising its Adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $133 million to $137 million, inclusive of the Intrepid Ranch acquisition. The $135 million midpoint compares to a $131 million midpoint in the Company’s prior guidance, with the $4 million increase reflecting approximately $2 million from Intrepid Ranch and approximately $2 million of additional organic growth.
